title: SiteMeasurementBatch
description: EWDS Topic schema for Client Gateway payload validation. Batch of interval measurement readings (int:SiteMeasurement) for multiple Sites, all belonging to the same Community. All fields other than timestamp are optional since not every metering point captures every quantity.

communityId.description: FK to the Community that all Sites in this batch belong to.

items.description: Measurement readings for one Site within the batch.

siteId.description: FK to the Site these measurements belong to.

items.description: A single interval measurement reading for a Site (int:SiteMeasurement).

tIndoorC.description: Indoor air temperature of the site in degrees Celsius. Only available where a temperature sensor is physically installed; not all INTELLIGENT pilot sites have indoor sensors.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the measurements are recorded. ISO 8601 with timezone.

energyIn.description: Average amount of energy imported per interval.

energyOut.description: Average amount of energy exported per interval.
